sql: SELECT periodo, nombre_fondo, orden, seccion, cuenta, valor_miles_mf, valor_anterior_miles_mf FROM ffmm_resultados WHERE run_fondo = (SELECT run_fondo FROM ffmm_balance WHERE codigo_cuenta = 'ActivoNetoAtribuibleALosParticipes' AND moneda = 'CLP' AND periodo = (SELECT max(periodo) FROM ffmm_balance) ORDER BY valor_miles_mf DESC LIMIT 1) AND periodo = (SELECT max(periodo) FROM ffmm_resultados) ORDER BY orden;
